name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 36 2022
information: BASC is proud to host a competition in San Jose again! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin'. # **IMPORTANT:** This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube. The main event is 3x3x3 Cube One-Handed. # Competitors are limited to ONE guest.
